note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Formiga hunts' (pressing the Korean player) through 'Korea pass back' (the back-pass is struck), 'too softly', 'Formiga nips in', 'slides it' to 'Goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pause at '...' so the move plays near real time. Chapter 3 swings round to her celebration on 'At thirty-seven'.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Montreal, 2015, the Women's World Cup. Brazil against South Korea. Formiga hunts in midfield, right behind her opponent. Korea pass back... too softly! Formiga nips in, and slides it past the keeper. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. She stays close to her opponent. The back-pass is slow, so she darts in and wins it.

chapters.label: Right foot
chapters.text: Her right foot rolls it into the corner. At thirty-seven, Formiga became the oldest goalscorer at a Women's World Cup!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay close to your opponent, and nip in when the pass is loose.
